Name: More Mine Ladders
Author: JadeTheavas
Description:
My first mod for this game! Just got back into playing the game, and while i was mining I realized I've never seen a mod for something like
this before, so I spent a few hours making it.

Normally a ladder can be created randomly when you first enter the
floor, when you kill a monster(~15% chance), or when the player breaks a
rock.

This mod allows you to configure the chance of a ladder being created
every time a rock is broken inside the mine. The chance is unaffected by
stones remaining & luck(unless enabled in the config).

[b]Requirements[/b]:
SMAPI 2.6-beta+

[b]Installation[/b]:
Use your preferred modloader to install or unzip the downloaded .zip file into your game's /Mods/ folder.

[b]Compatibility[/b]:
Shouldn't be incompatible with anything due to the way it patches the
method. You might run into some issues if a mod has similar
functionality.

[b][size=3][url=https://github.com/JadeTheavas/MoreMineLadders]Click here for source code[/url][/size][/b]

[b]Note[/b]:
Please report any issues you may run into using the mod while in multiplayer. Nothing *should* really cause any issues, but I can't really be sure.

To configure the ladder chance, edit the config.json in the modfolder. See the readme for details.

Should you run into any bugs/weird issues, or you have any suggestions, feel free to post them!
